title: Expectation of a Scalar Multiple
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces, with strictly positive coordinate weights summing to $1$, let $a\in\mathbb R$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the product outcome space. Then $\mathbb E_P[af]=a\mathbb E_Pf$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space
All coordinate weights are strictly positive and sum to $1
$f$ is real-valued on the product outcome space
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $a\in\mathbb R$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then $\mathbb E_P[af]=a\mathbb E_Pf$.
